reply:
CSS changes can fail visual snapshot tests in an integration suite. Snapshot tests capture rendered output; CSS alters rendering. So the failure is likely your change, not infra.

To confirm: check the CI logs for which tests failed and whether the diff shows visual mismatches from your CSS edits.

grade.note: It flips from infra to definitively blaming the CSS change while still suggesting a check, overcommitting beyond what evidence supports.
